description.description: An identification card for a member of the Kandahar Strike Force (QSF), NSU 03. The card features a circular emblem at the top, a portrait photo of a man, and personal details including name, rank, ID number, and blood type. It states the holder works in conjunction with Afghan and US Armed forces and provides a contact number for Fire Base GECKO.
